title: Multi-mode magneto-Rayleigh-Taylor (MRT) growth on a Be liner
description: Ellison benchmark 2 (arXiv:2504.10760 sec 3.2). Multi-mode MRT on a solid Be liner (AR=6) imploded by the published z2173 drive on Sandia Z, multi-mode-seeded by a random zone-by-zone temperature perturbation, radiation off. Validation is STAGED: Stage 1 (hard) = qualitative radiograph-morphology match exactly as Ellison; Stage 2 (soft) = quantitative anchor to McBride 2012 fit laws vs convergence. See validation_stages + data[].

primary_source.paper: Penetrating Radiography of Imploding and Stagnating Beryllium Liners on the Z Accelerator

companion_source.paper: Beryllium liner implosion experiments on the Z accelerator in preparation for magnetized liner inertial fusion

setup.drive: published z2173 current trace (McBride PRL 109,135004 Fig.1(d)); ~20 MA, 100-ns rise
setup.seed_model: random zone-by-zone Gaussian temperature perturbation (Ellison Eq.16): T0=293K, T_min=273K floor, exponential radial decay; multi-mode/broadband
setup.radiation: off (Ellison: negligible impact in this regime)

data.observable: MRT amplitude as a fraction of distance moved: (R_spike-R_bubble)/(R_outer(0)-R_bubble), in the nonlinear regime
data.extraction_method: Verbatim from McBride 2012 primary text: amplitude growth 'expressed as a fraction of the distance moved ... is nearly constant, and is in the range of 0.05-0.15'. Not pixel-traced; no fabrication. Dimensionless, timing- and drive-independent.

data.observable: MRT amplitude (R_spike-R_bubble) vs normalized distance moved x=1-R_bubble(t)/R_outer(0)
data.x_definition: x = 1 - R_bubble(t)/R_outer(0)  (R(t)=bubble radius, R(0)=initial outer radius)
data.extraction_method: Printed fit-law annotation transcribed verbatim from McBride 2012 Fig.7(a): '450*[1-R(t)/R(0)]-90'. No pixel-tracing of data points; faithful by construction. Experimental point scatter (~+/-30-60 um) defines the tolerance band.

data.observable: dominant MRT wavelength vs normalized distance moved x=1-R/R0
data.extraction_method: Printed fit-law annotation transcribed verbatim from McBride 2012 Fig.7(b): '750*[1-R(t)/R(0)]'. No pixel-tracing.

data.observable: inner / bubble / spike radii vs time (supporting only; used to reconstruct amplitude(t) for plots, NOT a binding gate)
data.extraction_method: Pixel-traced from McBride 2012 Fig.6 render by an automated agent; FLAGGED for human QC per ADR-0008 (autonomous image-read fabrication hazard). Supporting/illustrative only; the binding/soft anchors above are the transcribed fit laws + text fraction, not these points.

validation_stages.stage1_hard: qualitative radiograph-morphology match exactly as Ellison sec 3.2 (largest-mode amplitude, approximate dominant wavelength, macroscopic multimode structure) at matched convergence; BINDING.
validation_stages.stage2_soft: quantitative anchor to McBride 2012 primary fit laws (report-only, not binding).
validation_stages.stage3_escalate: if stage2 persistently misses, flag for human investigation rather than block.
validation_stages.note: Ellison B2 itself is purely qualitative (stage 1). Stage 2 extends beyond Ellison using McBride's own published fit laws; abscissa is convergence (1-R/R0), NOT absolute time, so it is immune to the shot-to-shot timing scatter Ellison cites as limiting absolute-time comparison.
